selection.edition: international Everhour REST API at api.everhour.com covering Composio EVERHOUR tools
selection.ownership: Everhour software is developed by Weavora Consulting LLC and resold by Software by Demand, Inc. (everhour.com terms). Hosting is AWS Oregon and Frankfurt. International time-tracking SaaS; not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official Everhour Apiary docs for X-Api-Key, GET /users/me, GET /team/users, GET /projects, GET /projects/{id}, GET /team/time, legal/security pages, and dated incident search (Everhour + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying Everhour platform compromise was identified in reviewed coverage. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Everhour REST API at api.everhour.com
research.searchCoverage: Official REST API is https://api.everhour.com with X-Api-Key. GET /users/me is the documented profile probe and pinned credential validator. GET /team/users, GET /projects, GET /projects/{id}, and GET /team/time are documented reads. Writes, timers, and task search are omitted. Developer is Weavora Consulting LLC; reseller Software by Demand, Inc. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying Everhour platform compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

healthcheck.description: Validate the Everhour API key with GET /users/me. Covers EVERHOUR_GET_USER_PROFILE.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

projects.get.description: Get one Everhour project by project ID. Covers EVERHOUR_GET_PROJECT.
projects.get.title: Get project

projects.list.description: List Everhour projects with optional text, limit, platform, and status filters. Covers EVERHOUR_LIST_PROJECTS.
projects.list.title: List projects

time.list.description: List Everhour team time records with optional date range and paging. AppCall-only; not a Composio tool.
time.list.title: List time records

users.list.description: List Everhour team users visible to the API key. Covers EVERHOUR_LIST_TEAM_MEMBERS.
users.list.title: List users

clients.create.title: Create Client
clients.create.description: Creates a new client in Everhour for tracking billable work, invoicing, and project organization. Covers EVERHOUR_CLIENT_CREATE.

name.description: The name of the client to create. This is the primary identifier shown in the Everhour UI.

projects.description: Optional list of project IDs (e.g., 'ev:123456789') to associate with this client.

businessDetails.description: Optional business details such as address, contact information, or other metadata for invoicing purposes.

clients.delete.title: Delete a client
clients.delete.description: Tool to delete a client. Use when you need to permanently remove a client from Everhour after confirming the client ID. Covers EVERHOUR_CLIENT_DELETE.

client_id.description: The unique numeric ID of the client to delete.

clients.list.title: List Clients
clients.list.description: Retrieves all clients in the Everhour workspace. Covers EVERHOUR_CLIENT_LIST.

timecards.clockIn.title: Clock In User
timecards.clockIn.description: Tool to clock in a user for time tracking. Use when you need to start a user's workday or shift in Everhour. Covers EVERHOUR_CLOCK_IN.

user_id.description: The unique numeric identifier of the user to clock in.

timecards.clockOut.title: Clock Out User
timecards.clockOut.description: Tool to clock out a user for time tracking. Use when you need to end a user's workday or shift in Everhour. Covers EVERHOUR_CLOCK_OUT.

user_id.description: The unique numeric identifier of the user to clock out.

webhooks.create.title: Create Webhook
webhooks.create.description: Tool to create a new webhook for event notifications in Everhour. Covers EVERHOUR_CREATE_WEBHOOK.

events.description: List of events to subscribe to.

project.description: Filter events by project ID. If set, only events from this project will trigger the webhook.

targetUrl.description: Target URL for webhook delivery. Must be a valid URL that responds to Everhour's validation request.

webhooks.delete.title: Delete Webhook
webhooks.delete.description: Tool to delete a webhook. Use when you need to permanently remove a webhook from Everhour after confirming the webhook ID. Covers EVERHOUR_DELETE_HOOK.

hook_id.description: The unique numeric ID of the webhook to delete.

timecards.delete.title: Delete a timecard
timecards.delete.description: Tool to delete a timecard for a user on a specific date. Covers EVERHOUR_DELETE_TIMECARD.

date.description: The date of the timecard to delete in YYYY-MM-DD format.

user_id.description: The unique numeric ID of the user whose timecard should be deleted.

timesheets.approval.discard.title: Discard Timesheet Approval
timesheets.approval.discard.description: Tool to discard a pending timesheet approval request. Covers EVERHOUR_DISCARD_TIMESHEET_APPROVAL.

timesheet_id.description: The unique numeric ID of the timesheet for which to discard the pending approval request.

expenses.list.title: List Expenses
expenses.list.description: Lists expense records from your Everhour workspace. Supports filtering by date range, user, project, category, and billable status. Covers EVERHOUR_EXPENSES_LIST.

to.description: End date for filtering expenses (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

from.description: Start date for filtering expenses (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: Maximum number of expenses to return.

clients.get.title: Get Client by ID
clients.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific client by ID. Covers EVERHOUR_GET_CLIENT.

client_id.description: The unique numeric identifier of the client.

sections.get.title: Get Section
sections.get.description: Retrieve details of a specific section by its ID. Sections are used to organize tasks within Everhour projects. Covers EVERHOUR_GET_SECTION.

sectionId.description: Numeric ID of the section to retrieve.

timecards.get.title: Get Timecard
timecards.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific timecard for a user on a date. Covers EVERHOUR_GET_TIMECARD.

date.description: Specific date for the timecard entry in YYYY-MM-DD format.

user_id.description: Team member identifier whose timecard is requested.

webhooks.get.title: Get Webhook
webhooks.get.description: Retrieve details of a specific webhook by its ID. Covers EVERHOUR_GET_WEBHOOK.

hook_id.description: The unique numeric identifier of the webhook.

expenseCategories.list.title: List Expense Categories
expenseCategories.list.description: Lists all expense categories available in your Everhour account. Covers EVERHOUR_LIST_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES.

webhooks.list.title: List Webhooks
webhooks.list.description: Lists all webhooks configured for the Everhour account. Covers EVERHOUR_LIST_HOOKS.

invoices.list.title: List Invoices
invoices.list.description: Retrieves all invoices from your Everhour workspace. Covers EVERHOUR_LIST_INVOICES.

sections.list.title: List Sections
sections.list.description: Lists all sections within a specific Everhour project. Covers EVERHOUR_LIST_SECTIONS.

projectId.description: The unique identifier of the project to list sections for.

tags.list.title: List Tags
tags.list.description: List all tags in the Everhour workspace. Covers EVERHOUR_LIST_TAGS.

teams.get.title: List Teams
teams.get.description: Retrieves information about the authenticated team/workspace in Everhour. Covers EVERHOUR_LIST_TEAMS.

timecards.list.title: List Timecards
timecards.list.description: Tool to retrieve all team timecards with optional date filtering. Covers EVERHOUR_LIST_TIMECARDS.

to.description: End date for filtering timecards (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

from.description: Start date for filtering timecards (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

users.timecards.list.title: List User Timecards
users.timecards.list.description: Tool to retrieve timecards for a specific user with optional date filtering. Covers EVERHOUR_LIST_USER_TIMECARDS.

to.description: End date for filtering timecards (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

from.description: Start date for filtering timecards (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

user_id.description: Numeric ID of the user whose timecards to retrieve.

users.timesheets.list.title: List User Timesheets
users.timesheets.list.description: Tool to retrieve timesheets for a specific user. Covers EVERHOUR_LIST_USER_TIMESHEETS.

limit.description: Maximum number of weeks to retrieve.

user_id.description: Unique identifier of the user whose timesheets to retrieve.

projects.create.title: Create Project
projects.create.description: Tool to create a new project in Everhour. Covers EVERHOUR_PROJECT_CREATE.

client.description: Numeric ID of the client to associate with the project.

projects.delete.title: Delete a project
projects.delete.description: Tool to delete a project. Use when you need to permanently remove a project from Everhour after confirming the project ID. Covers EVERHOUR_PROJECT_DELETE.

project_id.description: Unique identifier of the project to delete. Format is 'ev:{numeric_id}' for native Everhour projects.

timesheets.approval.request.title: Request Timesheet Approval
timesheets.approval.request.description: Tool to request approval for a timesheet or approve a week (for admins). Covers EVERHOUR_REQUEST_TIMESHEET_APPROVAL.

comment.description: Optional text feedback or comment to include with the approval request.

reviewer.description: Admin user ID who will review the timesheet submission.

timesheetId.description: Unique identifier of the timesheet to request approval for or approve.

sendNotification.description: Whether to send a notification to the reviewer when requesting approval.

sections.create.title: Create Section
sections.create.description: Tool to create a new section in a project. Covers EVERHOUR_SECTION_CREATE.

name.description: Name of the section to be created.

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project to add the section to.

sections.delete.title: Delete a section
sections.delete.description: Tool to delete a section. Use when you need to permanently remove a section from Everhour after confirming the section ID. Covers EVERHOUR_SECTION_DELETE.

section_id.description: Numeric ID of the section to delete.

tasks.create.title: Create Task
tasks.create.description: Creates a new task in an Everhour project. Use this to add tasks for time tracking. Covers EVERHOUR_TASK_CREATE.

name.description: Name/title of the task to create.

tags.description: List of tag IDs to apply to the task.

parent.description: Parent task ID to create this as a subtask.

section.description: Section ID to place the task in.

assignee.description: User ID to assign the task to.

estimate.description: Time estimate for the task in seconds.

projectId.description: The Everhour project ID where the task will be created.

timers.start.title: Start Timer
timers.start.description: Tool to start a new timer for a task. Use when you need to begin tracking time on a specific task. Covers EVERHOUR_TIMER_START.

task.description: The Everhour task ID to start the timer on. Format: 'ev:<numeric_id>'.

clients.update.title: Update Client
clients.update.description: Tool to update an existing client in Everhour. Covers EVERHOUR_UPDATE_CLIENT.

id.description: Numeric ID of the client to update.

businessDetails.description: Business details or address information for the client.

projects.update.title: Update an existing project
projects.update.description: Updates an existing Everhour project's settings. Use this to modify project name, budget, billing configuration, or notes. Covers EVERHOUR_UPDATE_PROJECT.

billable.description: Whether the project is billable by default.

project_id.description: The unique project identifier in format 'ev:XXXXXXXXX'.

budgetIncludeExpenses.description: Whether to include expenses in the budget.

timecards.update.title: Update Timecard
timecards.update.description: Tool to update a timecard for a user on a specific date. Covers EVERHOUR_UPDATE_TIMECARD.

date.description: Date for the timecard in YYYY-MM-DD format.

clockIn.description: Clock in time in user's local timezone using HH:MM format.

user_id.description: Numeric ID of the user whose timecard is being updated.

clockOut.description: Clock out time in user's local timezone using HH:MM format.

webhooks.update.title: Update Webhook
webhooks.update.description: Tool to update an existing webhook configuration in Everhour. Covers EVERHOUR_UPDATE_WEBHOOK.

events.description: List of events to subscribe to.
